_comment: Regression baseline for the sankey-chart demo. Run build_spec.py on mapping.json against tickets.xlsx (or a fresh make_demo_data.py output) and every number below must match exactly. All values are synthetic.

sheet_row_counts_for_reference._note: Escalations is excluded from the population. Every one of its Parent values is a Service Desk ticket, so reading it would double-count 25 tickets and inflate the population from 400 to 425.

precedence_check._note: All 20 Duplicate tickets carry Status Closed. With the Duplicate rule placed after the Closed rule they would land in done, which would read 220 instead of 200.
